4016:6537.name: Avatar
4016:6537.description:
Usage
The avatar component has a predefined set of sizes:
100: 24x24 (size--700)
200: 32x32 (size--900)
300: 48x48 (size--1100)
400: 64x64 (size--1200)
500: 80x80 (size--1300)
600: 96x96 (size--1400)
Please use only these options. If some other size is crucial, please contact the UX team.


Keywords
User, person, userpic

2254:865.name: Focus ring
2254:865.description:
Usage
In itslearning we override browser’s focus ring style. You might see different focus ring styles in the system, but only this one is a part of Prometheus (blue 3px outline with 2px offset) and should be used in mockups.


How to use in Figma
Add an instance of this component inside another component or frame. Apply an absolute position if the parent is auto layout.
Make the size of the focus ring the same as the parent, position X:0 and Y:0. Make the focus ring attaches to Left and right and Tops and bottom.
If the focus ring is in a component, create a visibility property for it. The focus ring is hidden by default in all components.


Customization
The focus ring style might be changed to work better for a specific component, e.g. border radius was increased for a switch.
Customizations should be used sparingly. For the majority of components, the standard focus ring style works well. Overlaps and small visual shift are acceptable.

4675:10050.name: Button
4675:10050.description:
Usage
Large is a default size of the button. The small size can be used in some specific cases when the large one is too big.
The button width depends on its label.
The button can't lead to another page — use the link instead.
Truncate button's label if it doesn’t fit. Button label should never wrap. Avoid such long labels and translations. Truncating is a way to handle exception cases, but in the end the copy has to be updated.


Loading
The button can be in the loading state: the button text is hidden and a spinner is shown in its place. Maintain the width that it would have if the text were visible. For examples, see the Styleguide.


Row of actions
The distance between actions is defined in the variable actions-gap.
The behaviour of a row of actions is handled by the ButtonGroup component. We don't have any analogue in Figma, for designers it is simple row inside an Auto Layout. Feel free to the refer to the ButtonGroup component in communication with developers.

4680:13737.name: Select
4680:13737.description:
Usage
Use when there’re 5+ options.
Use for the least important actions so the user isn’t distracted by secondary tasks.
Can also be used for a set of actions that won’t fit in the available screen space.


Label on the left
Label on the left should not be used in forms. It can be helpful in toolbars above lists or tables. Label on the left would not work for multiline version of component.


Keywords
select, dropdown
